title: Permission catalogue
description: Canonical catalogue of every permission code used in the system. Source of truth for: (a) RBAC bundle expansion (rbac.arch.json roles[*].permission_bundle of kind=all/exclude_patterns/match_pattern); (b) hard validation of @PreAuthorize codes emitted by the module generator; (c) the rendered permissoes.md catalogue document. D-060.

$comment.description: Free-text note for maintainers; not consumed by any generator.

prefix.description: Permission namespace prefix (e.g. 'com', 'est'). Matches the leading token of each permission code in this module.

package.description: Java package suffix (e.g. 'comercial'). Optional — used by the rendered catalogue document.

items.description: Full permission code (e.g. 'com.orcamento.criar'). May contain `{{ var }}` placeholders that get interpolated against project vars at render time. Each entry MUST start with '<prefix>.' (validated structurally).

modules.description: Ships EMPTY in the source of truth (D-103 Gap B); projects fill it via arch/overrides/<aspect>.partial.json (D-074 deep-merge).
